source.coverage: Exact boundingBox is authoritative; station reference and map query center may differ. No complete distant skyline or terrain is claimed.
source.changes: Selected up to 650 nearest building ways plus all building parts and buildings carrying height/levels/name tags, and roads/water/wood/parks/grass ways. Selected ground furniture/viewpoint/tree/tower nodes retain their source coordinates and tags, without editing metadata. Source IDs, tags and geometry preserved; OSM API way node references resolve to returned original node coordinates. Bounding-box coverage may be partial; included relation membership is retained but missing outer members are not invented. Relation multipolygons and terrain not reconstructed. Unmapped architectural details and missing heights must not be described as exact.

tags.note: a 봉수대 signal station. fire and smoke telegraph system. this one had a five fire code used to warn of war state. There used to be five of these at the site but only this one was rebuilt in 1993. they used to conect to a network of 673 others.
